required_semantics: One immutable raw bundle per accepted acquisition block; all source data are separate context
Raw SD, weighted SEM, Allan SEM and expanded uncertainty remain distinct categories
No plot digitization, padded reading, interpolation into observations, substitution or source-value reward
Reference and test orientation must be qualified; listed winding integers cannot infer routing
Short screens never receive long-record Allan uncertainty labels
Reference current/power logged independently for each resistor and chip region
Shared-ref and apparatus links persist across indirect paths
Scientific disagreement is a valid outcome, not an automatic retry request
